key_uncertainties.nature: Gridded census disaggregation vs real-time occupancy
key_uncertainties.mitigation: Reported as DATASET_SPREAD. Both primary and cross-check datasets are preserved and documented without cherry-picking.
key_uncertainties.interpretation: Population counts are modelled gridded estimates and should be interpreted as a sensitivity range/context, not two measurements of the same true population. WorldPop 2020 = PRIMARY; GHSL 2025 = CROSS_CHECK (DATASET_SPREAD ~2x). Do NOT average or combine the two datasets.

key_uncertainties.nature: No site-specific building height, masonry type, or engineering fragility curves
key_uncertainties.mitigation: Classified conservatively as H5_H6_STRUCTURAL_DAMAGE_EXPOSURE based strictly on CWC H5/H6 hydrodynamic thresholds (D*V > 1.0 m2/s or D > 2.0 m). Buildings are NOT assumed destroyed.
key_uncertainties.cwc_wording_h5: Buildings vulnerable to structural damage; some less robust buildings may be subject to failure
key_uncertainties.cwc_wording_h6: All building types considered vulnerable to failure

key_uncertainties.nature: No surveyed bridge deck elevation or scour rating in screening dataset
key_uncertainties.mitigation: Classified as BRIDGE_HYDRAULIC_EXPOSURE_SCREENING. Screened bridges are NOT assumed collapsed.

key_uncertainties.nature: No crop calendar, crop stage, market prices, or economic damage curves
key_uncertainties.mitigation: Monetary damage and crop loss modeling declared NOT_IMPLEMENTED_IN_M8.

key_uncertainties.nature: No empirical fatality rates (e.g. Graham 1999 or RCEM) parameterized for local warning compliance
key_uncertainties.mitigation: Potential loss of life model declared NOT_IMPLEMENTED to prevent speculative casualty figures.

response_zone_geometry.exclusive_zone_construction: Face-level chainage projection — each face assigned to exactly one sector
response_zone_geometry.polygon_buffer_residual_note: Sector polygons are built by buffering face point clusters; underlying face-level and pixel-level assignment guarantees zero double-counting in all vector and raster quantities.
